title: kummer iso derived unit
statement: In the site and derived-category setting of residue Kummer reduction [lem-sp-residue-kummer-derived-unit], suppose 0→K→G→G→0 has last map n>0 and f:K≅UH for a ULift(Z/n)-module sheaf H. Then the connecting class followed by mk0(f) is a degree-one derived Ext unit [def-sp-derived-scalar-ext-unit].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: Replace the kernel map by f inverse followed by the original inclusion. The resulting short complex is isomorphic to the original one and is therefore short exact. Apply the residue Kummer unit theorem to it. Naturality of Ext classes for the isomorphism of short exact sequences identifies its class with the original connecting class followed by f.

theorem kummer_iso_derived_unit (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (K G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (H : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wAb} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wMod}
      (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))))]
    [HasExt.{wE} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(sheafCompose J (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))]
    (i : K ⟶ G) (hi : i ≫ (n • 𝟙 G) = 0)
    (hK : (ShortComplex.mk i (n • 𝟙 G) hi).ShortExact)
    (f : K ≅ (sheafCompose J (forget₂
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj H) :
    (sheafCompose J (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).DerivedExtUnit G H 1
        (hK.extClass.comp (Ext.mk₀ f.hom) (add_zero 1))
